Pairwise t-tests with Cohen's d for every pair of conditions

Source: R/tests.R
cr_ttest.Rd

Compares groups two at a time (all pairs, each versus a reference, or pairs you choose), with Welch t-tests, a multiple-comparison correction across the pairs, and Cohen's d (or Hedges' g) with a noncentral-t CI. cr_d() is the same function, named for when d is what you are after.

Usage

cr_ttest(
  data,
  dv,
  group,
  pairs = "all",
  ref = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  by = NULL,
  adjust = "holm",
  dv_adjust = "none",
  effect = c("d", "g"),
  conf_level = 0.95,
  labels = NULL,
  level_labels = NULL,
  dv_labels = NULL,
  clean_labels = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

dv

One or more outcome columns.

group

Grouping (condition) column.

pairs

"all" (every pair), "ref" (each level versus ref), or specific pairs as "Loss vs. Control" strings or c("Loss", "Control") vectors. Each pair reports the first level minus the second.

ref

Reference level when pairs = "ref" (default: first level).

id

Participant column for within-subject (paired) comparisons.

by

Optional column: run every comparison within each subgroup.

adjust

Correction across the pairs of each outcome (any stats::p.adjust() method). When on, CIs (mean difference and d) are Bonferroni-adjusted to match, e.g. 98.3% CIs for 3 pairs, so a CI that excludes zero agrees with the corrected p. adjust = "none" gives ordinary 95% CIs.

dv_adjust

Correction across outcomes for each pair. CIs widen to match (Bonferroni across pairs x outcomes).

effect

"d" (Cohen's d: pooled SD between subjects, d_z paired) or "g" (Hedges' small-sample correction).

conf_level

Confidence level.

labels, level_labels, dv_labels, clean_labels

Display labels, as in clean_regress().

Value

A cr_tests object.

Examples

d <- data.frame(cond = rep(c("Control", "Gain", "Loss"), each = 30),
                trust = rnorm(90, rep(c(3, 3.4, 3.1), each = 30)))
cr_d(d, "trust", "cond")                    # all three pairs
#> Welch t-test (3 results)
#> p-values adjusted: Holm across pairs; CIs Bonferroni-adjusted for 3 comparisons (98.3% level) 
#>   Trust ~ Cond [Gain vs. Control]
#>     Mdiff = 0.78, 98.3% CI [0.09, 1.47], t(58.00) = 2.79, p = .022, d = 0.72, 98.3% CI [0.08, 1.35]
#>   Trust ~ Cond [Loss vs. Control]
#>     Mdiff = 0.49, 98.3% CI [-0.18, 1.16], t(57.81) = 1.80, p = .153, d = 0.47, 98.3% CI [-0.16, 1.09]
#>   Trust ~ Cond [Loss vs. Gain]
#>     Mdiff = -0.29, 98.3% CI [-0.96, 0.38], t(57.82) = -1.06, p = .293, d = -0.27, 98.3% CI [-0.89, 0.35]
cr_d(d, "trust", "cond", pairs = "ref")      # each vs. Control
#> Welch t-test (2 results)
#> p-values adjusted: Holm across pairs; CIs Bonferroni-adjusted for 2 comparisons (97.5% level) 
#>   Trust ~ Cond [Gain vs. Control]
#>     Mdiff = 0.78, 97.5% CI [0.14, 1.42], t(58.00) = 2.79, p = .014, d = 0.72, 97.5% CI [0.12, 1.31]
#>   Trust ~ Cond [Loss vs. Control]
#>     Mdiff = 0.49, 97.5% CI [-0.14, 1.12], t(57.81) = 1.80, p = .077, d = 0.47, 97.5% CI [-0.12, 1.05]
